capabilities: Preview converted article content with live refresh while editing
Upload note images, Obsidian embeds, and downloadable web images to X
Crop and set a 5:2 cover image from note or local files
Save the note as an X Article draft via the logged-in Chrome session
Resume an interrupted save with its existing draft and uploaded images
disambiguation: The plugin only saves drafts in X; you finish editing and publish the article there yourself.
extras: Listed as not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Requires nontrivial external setup (Node.js, Playwright MCP, Chrome extension, connection token) and does not support Obsidian mobile. Free and open source (AGPL-3.0-only); explicitly needs no X developer API key or AI service. README is in Chinese. Format support is limited: code blocks, tables, nested lists, Dataview and video are not converted.
problem: X has no Markdown import for Articles, so turning a note into a long-form post means manually reformatting text and re-uploading every image.

relations.evidence: 插件启动本机已安装的 Playwright MCP 来连接 Chrome
沿用登录状态：连接日常使用的 Chrome，使用其中已登录的 X 账号

summary: Publishing tool that converts Markdown notes into X long-form Article drafts, uploading images and reusing your Chrome X login session.
